scope: Direct-source follow-up on five remaining null-race CaC-usable skills.

records.name: Consecutive Energy Blast
records.finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference and prior repository reconciliation establish Skill Shop/CaC availability and broad character use, but no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction. Character presets using the skill are not race eligibility evidence.

records.name: Core Breaker
records.finding: Current Xenoverse 2 character documentation confirms Core Breaker as Gamma 2's Ultimate, while the recovered canonical/research layer marks it CaC-usable. No explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction was established; Gamma 2 being an Android is character ownership, not CaC restriction evidence.

records.name: Full Power Energy Wave
records.finding: Dedicated skill research establishes Skill Shop/story-gated acquisition and extremely broad character availability, including multiple races and customizable partners, but does not establish a narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction.

records.name: Gigantic Cross
records.finding: Current Broly documentation lists Gigantic Cross among Broly's Ki Blast Supers and the canonical record is CaC-usable. No direct retail eligibility wording establishing a CaC race/gender/form restriction was recovered.

records.name: Gigantic Nova
records.finding: Dedicated skill research establishes Conton City Patrol 17 acquisition and Broly/Customize Partner association, but no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction. Broly character ownership does not establish a CaC restriction.

next: Continue the remaining null-race cohort with direct retail eligibility evidence.
